result.rationale: Verifiable from the diff: totalPages uses Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1, so with user_count=50 and limit=50 it yields 2 pages. The 'next' action clamps offset to Math.min(offset+limit, user_count) = 50, and the API (groups_controller#members) applies limit 50 offset 50, returning an empty list. showingLast compares currentPage (which would be 2) to totalPages (2) so it permits navigation to the phantom page. Off-by-one is real.

judged_text: Off-by-one pagination bug in admin-group.js.es6: `totalPages = Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` produces a phantom last page when `user_count % limit == 0` — with the default limit of 50, a group with exactly 50 members shows totalPages: 2, and clicking 'next' sets offset to 50, returning an empty member list to the admin.

record.issue_text: Off-by-one pagination bug in admin-group.js.es6: `totalPages = Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` produces a phantom last page when `user_count % limit == 0` — with the default limit of 50, a group with exactly 50 members shows totalPages: 2, and clicking 'next' sets offset to 50, returning an empty member list to the admin.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which yields an extra page when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 50/50 => 2). The `next` action then sets `offset` to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, so from 0 it becomes 50, and `Group#findMembers` requests `offset=50`. The server (`GroupsController#members`) applies `.limit(limit).offset(offset)`, so `offset=50` with `total=50` returns an empty `members` list. This matches the described phantom last page behavior.
